page.overview:
Who is Absorbing Kid from the Sky?

Absorbing Kid from the Sky, known as Absorption Child in the Japanese version, is a character version of the card, "Absorbing Kid from the Sky".

In Yu-Gi-Oh! 5D's World Championship 2009: Stardust Accelerator, Absorbing Kid from the Sky appears as an unlockable opponent and is tag partners with Telekinetic Shocker.
